decisions.decision: main incremental validation; complete candidates manually or when preparing a release
retain Docker/Bake; pilot immutable component handoff for one toolchain and one Python row
select affected components and downstream dependencies; distinguish build invalidation from qualification and supply metadata invalidation; conservatively select full validation for unknown changes

optimize current GitHub runners and stage concurrency first; retain local Docker/Bake validation; rebaseline after component handoff, then test Python max-parallel 2 to 3 and increase only with evidence

reuse trusted component evidence only when complete artifact, input, test and environment identities match; re-execute candidate-bound integration and native ARM gates for each new candidate; retain explicit forced replay
decisions.implementation_dependency: GCC full requires prepared sources and build context in addition to installed compiler/sysroot; retain these separately from downstream installation components

decisions.decision: retain standard-library Python and existing user CLI; refactor explicit domain modules in batches alongside CI/component changes; start with component identity, evidence handoff and incremental planning, then RPM, ABI and Python qualification as dependencies permit
constraints: Preserve minimal per-stage Docker source dependencies
Preserve Rocky 8 platform-python compatibility where required
Extend compatibility validation to nested modules when introduced

local_docker_validation.test_environment: Debian 12, Python 3.11.2, 4 CPUs, 16 GiB memory limit, no network, read-only repository; not identical to the Ubuntu CI host
local_docker_validation.build_hardware: 32 logical CPUs, approximately 125 GiB RAM; no GitHub VM CPU/memory quota imposed on builder
local_docker_validation.source_snapshot: git -c tar.umask=0022 archive HEAD; source files 0644/0755
local_docker_validation.workspace_modes: 0664/0775 before controlled snapshot; initial source download attempt deliberately interrupted

component_pilot.qualification_scope: toolchain-abi-and-two-smoke-tiers; not GCC-full or complete Python row qualification
component_pilot.registry_cache_imports: Read-only registry imports retained for other Python and host dependencies; not a fully cold/no-cache experiment
component_pilot.artifact_location: Local OCI layout only; no registry publication

vcpkg and GCC branch durations unchanged; inputs, toolchains, final SDK and publish excluded
